description:
Get campaign fees

Returns what registering a campaign bills the selected organization: the non-refundable registration fee, charged again on every resubmission, and the monthly fee each campaign bills from carrier approval. Amounts are list prices read from billing; tax is not included. Show them before creating or resubmitting a campaign.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/10dlc-campaigns/get-campaign-fees
name: getTenDlcCampaignFees

campaignMonthly.description: Billed each month for each campaign, starting when carriers approve it.

amount.description: The list price in major units of currency, as a decimal string such as "20" or "15.50". Tax is not included.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as USD.

campaignRegistration.description: Charged when a campaign is registered, and again on every resubmission. Non-refundable.

amount.description: The list price in major units of currency, as a decimal string such as "20" or "15.50". Tax is not included.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as USD.

title: Get campaign fees
